notes.title: Watch Me Jump is now free!!!
notes.notes:
Hey any and every body who is following news of this game.

I just wanted to give you a quick update about the pricing of Watch Me Jump: there isn't any. Not anymore.

Yes, starting now, Watch Me Jump is available to download and play completely free. No microtransactions, no free-to-play items, no cosmetics, and no upfront pricing. You get 100% of the game for completely free.

It's been a wild four years since releasing the game, and I think it's about time to make it available for anybody who wants to play it, regardless of income.

A huge thank you to everybody who paid for the game over the past four years. You all spent a little time and a little dough supporting a super small indie game, and for that I'm incredibly grateful.

And now ... I'm off to work on the next title! See you soon!

notes.title: Watch Me Jump nominated for IGF's Excellence in Narrative Award!
notes.notes:
It is beyond exciting to announce that Watch Me Jump has been named a finalist for that very Excellence in Narrative Award.

Many of the games that inspired the creation of Watch Me Jump have been nominees in the past, including Gone Home, Her Story, The Stanley Parable, Papers, Please, Virginia, The Beginner's Guide, Kentucky Route Zero, and of course, Undertale.

So it's a true honor to be on this list, and to be on it with the other amazing finalists.

A huge thank you to everyone who's played the game, talked about it, loved it, hated it, felt anything in between. I'm incredibly grateful.

notes.title: Watch Me Jump named one of the best Unknown Pleasures of 2018 by RPS!
notes.notes:
Once again, I am grateful for the words of Sin Vega at Rock, Paper, Shotgun, whose praise for Watch Me Jump back in May was instrumental in its success. Vega has named Watch Me Jump one of the eight best Unknown Pleasures of 2018, and in doing so, has written some of the best words anyone has ever said about something I've written.

Check out the review below, and if you haven't purchased the game yet, it's part of the Steam Winter Sale, so you have until January 3 to get the game for even cheaper than it usually is.

https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/2018/12/21/the-best-of-unknown-pleasures-2018/2/

notes.title: Watch Me Jump Sale Next Week!
notes.notes:
I'm excited to announce that Watch Me Jump is going to be available on iOS and Android starting next week! 

The mobile port will be released on July 11th (the day that the Minnesota Lynx and Indiana Fever face off), and to celebrate, we're having a week-long sale on Steam. From July 9th through the 16th, both the game and the soundtrack will be 40% off! 

So if you've been looking at it on your wishlist, wondering when would be the right time to buy it ... that time would be now! (And by now, I mean Monday.)

notes.title: Watch Me Jump is an RPS Pick of the Week!
notes.notes:
A HUGE thank you to Sin Vega at Rock, Paper, Shotgun for not only naming Watch Me Jump as one of the "five great Steam games you missed", but naming it Pick of the Week!

The article is below ...

https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/2018/04/30/unknown-pleasures-a-five-course-menu-of-great-new-games/

notes.title: Watch Me Jump is out!!!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Watch Me Jump was released yesterday for PC and Mac! The game retails for $4.99, but from now until April 26th, you can buy the game at 20% off!

Also, the soundtrack is available to purchase for an additional $1.99.

Happy playing!

notes.title: Watch Me Jump - Coming Soon for PC and Mac!
notes.notes:
I'm pleased to announce that on the release date of April 19th, 2018, Watch Me Jump will be available for purchase for both PC and Mac!

Along with that, you'll be able to buy the soundtrack to the game, with 19 original tracks (and one public domain marching song).

More updates as they develop. Thanks, everyone!

- Jeremy
